explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly validates GPT-4 judgments against human evaluations using Cohen's Kappa metric on the same set of 100 samples across four professional dimensions

prompts.notes: Prompt templates are detailed in Appendix D.2, with specific evaluation rules for each dimension incorporated into the {demand} field of the prompt template

guidelines.notes: Human evaluations are based on the same four professional dimensions (helpfulness, thoroughness, credibility, feasibility) with independent evaluations by experts from various professional fields

sample_size.notes: 100 samples were independently evaluated by both GPT-4 and human experts across four professional fields

quantitative_scores.notes: Average score across all four metrics; individual dimension scores not reported separately

correlation_interpretation.threshold_used: Cohen's kappa of 0.62 indicates substantial agreement

validation_results.summary_finding: GPT-4 evaluations achieved an average Cohen's kappa score of 0.62 with human experts, indicating a high degree of consistency between LLM and human assessments across all four professional dimensions.

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluations used identical criteria across all four professional dimensions with no differences in evaluation criteria
